name: MELD — Multi-centre Epilepsy Lesion Detection cohort + MELD Graph

access.licence: Data on request; MELD Graph code PolyForm Noncommercial + registration licence file
access.steps: Request data access via the project website; register to obtain a MELD licence to run MELD Graph.

cohort.age: test cohort mean 18.0 y (IQR 11–29): mostly paediatric/young adult
cohort.sites: 23 centres (MELD Graph); 22 in MELD FCD (618 patients + 397 controls)

format: 34 surface-based features per vertex + manual lesion masks (not raw volumes)
outcomes: Post-surgical outcome for 361 of 419 operated (68% Engel 1) in MELD FCD
caveats: Raw MRI is not shared; data are surface features
Cohort size depends on the study: 1,015 participants (MELD FCD, 22 centres) or 1,185 (MELD Graph, 23 centres)
checks: Full text PMC9679165 (data availability); JAMA Neurol abstract; MELD site and meld_graph repo (licence).
pipeline: Use the tool, not the data: run MELD Graph on IDEAS / Bonn / Penn T1+FLAIR to produce lesion maps as EZ priors.
key_claim: Large multicentre FCD cohort available only on request; the open MELD Graph model is the usable part.

evidence.quote: collated and harmonized a retrospective MRI cohort of 1015 participants, 618 patients with focal FCD-related epilepsy and 397 controls, from 22 epilepsy centres worldwide.
Requests for access to the MELD dataset can be made through the project website
703 patients with FCD-related epilepsy and 482 controls
